FEDERAL LEVIES FORCE REGULATION, 2010
FEDERAL LEVIES FORCE REGULATION, 2010
A Regulation to constitute and
regulate
the Federal Levies Force
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
25th June, 2010]
Whereas it is expedient
to constitute and regulate the service matter of the Federal Levies Force for
the purposes hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore in
exercise of the powers conferred by clause (5)of Article 247 of the
Constitution of Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make
and promulgate the following Regulations, namely:--
CHAPTER - I
1. Short title
extent and commencement.---(1)
This regulation may be called the Federal Levies Force Regulation, 2010.
(2) It shall apply
to all the Federal Levies personnel in the Federally Administered Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come
into force at once.
2. Definitions.---(1) In this regulation unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context,
(a)
"Commandant" means a person appointed by the Federal
Government to be the commander of the Force;
(b) "Competent
Authority" means an officer or authority designated as such by
the Commandant;
(c)
"FATA" means Federally Administered Tribunal Areas;
(d)
"Force" means Federal Levies Force constituted under section 3;
(e)
"instructions" means instructions issued under this regulation;
(f)
"prescribed" means prescribed by rules and instructions,
under this regulation; and
(g)
"rules" means rules made under this regulation.
CHAPTER - II
3. Power to
constitute and maintain the Force and 'its functions.-(1) The Federal Government may constitute and
maintain a force to be called the Federal Levies Force for performing the
following functions, namely:
(a) ensuring
security of roads in the FATA;
(b) ensuring
security and manning of pickets;
(c) guarding
Government institutions or installations;
(d) ensuring
security of jail guards and arrested criminals;
(e) general
maintaining of law and order and providing mobile escort to very important
persons;
(f) anti smuggling
activities;
(g) destruction
of illicit crops;
(h) serving
of summon or procedures;
(i) policing,
investigation and prosecution in certain areas as notified by the Federal
Government; and
(j) such
other functions as the Federal Government may, by notification in the official
Gazette,. require the Force to perform.
(2) In the discharge of their functions the officers
and staff shall be guided in accordance with this regulation and the rules made
there under.
4. Constitution of Force.---(1) The head of
the Force shall be the Commandant to be appointed by the Federal Government.
(2) The
Force shall consist of such ranks and number of officers and members and shall
be constituted in such manner as may be prescribed by rules.
(3) The
officers and members shall receive such pay, pension, allowances and other remunerations and shall enjoy such leave and other
privileges as may be prescribed by rules from time to time.
(4) Officers
and members of the force shall wear such uniform as may be prescribed by rules
or orders.
5. Administration of the Force.---(l) The
administration of the force shall vest in the
Commandant who shall administer it in accordance with the provisions of
this regulations, rules and such orders and instructions as may be made or
issued by the Federal Government from time to time.
(2) The Commandant shall exercise his powers and
perform his functions under the general supervision and direction of the
Federal Government.
6. Powers and duties of officers and members.-(l)
An officer or member of the Force shall,--
(a) take effective measures for ensuring security of
assigned jurisdiction and for safeguarding against acts of unlawful
interference;
(b) prevent unauthorized person and vehicle from
access to the territorial jurisdiction;
(e) take effective measure for preventing, sabotage,
placement of car bombs, letter bombs, dangerous article, and carriage of arms
and ammunitions into the restricted area;
